SWZ.note: The document names no national broadband plan or its targets.
The document says nothing about an exchange point.
The EPTC infrastructure rebuild is said to strengthen the telecommunications backbone, but no long-distance fibre between regions is stated; home passes are fibre to homes.
It gives cross-border capacity in Gbps (1 to 10 Gbps, total 120 Gbps) but names no cable or fibre route.
No share of people using the internet is given.
No mobile data price or share of income is given.
The document says nothing about satellite broadband.
